statBlock.name: Blink Dog
statBlock.description: A Feywild hound that vanishes and reappears as it runs. Blink dogs may join centaurs and pixies on hunts that cross into other worlds.

sections.Languages: Blink Dog. It understands Elvish and Sylvan and can't speak either.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport (recharge 4–6). The dog teleports up to 40 ft. to a vacant space it can see.

statBlock.name: Death Dog
statBlock.description: A two-headed desert hound that targets weakened prey. It may retreat after a bite and stalk the victim until the infection takes hold.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned. While Poisoned in this way, finishing a Long Rest does not restore its hit point maximum to normal. It repeats the save every 24 hours, ending the effect on a success. Each failed repeat save reduces its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10).

statBlock.name: Griffon
statBlock.description: A hunter with the body of a big cat and the head and wings of a raptor. The familiar eagle-and-lion form is one of several breeds.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a hit, a Medium or smaller creature is also Grappled by both front claws, escape DC 14.

statBlock.name: Hippogriff
statBlock.description: Part horse and part bird of prey, a hippogriff hunts as it migrates. Some carry riders who offer food or aid.

sections.Traits: Flyby. An enemy cannot make an Opportunity Attack when the hippogriff leaves that enemy's reach by flying.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Pegasus
statBlock.description: An intelligent winged horse often found in secluded pastures or on floating islands. Some serve deities of the Feywild or Upper Planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. It can't speak.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

statBlock.name: Roc
statBlock.description: A giant bird of prey that can lift an elephant or a wagon and carry it back to a distant nest.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Beak attacks. The roc can replace one of them with Talons.
Beak. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. On a hit, a Huge or smaller creature is also Grappled by both talons, escape DC 19. It is Restrained for as long as this grapple lasts.
sections.Bonus actions: Swoop (recharge 5–6). If the roc has a creature Grappled, it flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then drops the creature.

statBlock.name: Winter Wolf
statBlock.description: A horse-sized, speaking wolf that hunts in packs across the tundra. It can freeze prey with its breath.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the wolf is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally isn't Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. It takes 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
